verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud lets you create agent runs through an API. These execute autonomously on managed cloud browsers while you poll ordered events to monitor them, so one-off tasks do run unattended in the background. However, the evidence shows no recurring schedules, triggers or saved automations. Each run is a one-off API call, and a one-off run is not a recurring automation. missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automation setup, event or trigger-based automation, documented background or async job lifecycle, independent corroboration of unattended operation

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
